svg.title: Отжимания между скамьями — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. Draw a precise two-phase exercise diagram of the feet-elevated bench dip. Full side view at equal scale. The man is fully dressed in a fitted T-shirt, shorts and athletic shoes. Each panel MUST visibly contain TWO distinct freestanding flat exercise benches with equal top heights, a short gap between the benches, the man's body suspended in that gap. The rear bench is behind his hips, and his hands grip the front edge of its seat. The front bench is by his feet, with BOTH heels resting clearly on top of it, feet off the floor, knees nearly straight. In the left panel his arms support him almost straight and his hips are above the rear seat. In the right panel his elbows bend back and his hips travel down close to the rear seat, with heels still on the front bench. The hands and heels do not move. Draw clean bench supports and a visible separation between the two benches. Do not place heels on the floor or sit on either bench. Use a very wide empty vertical gutter between the two drawings. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
